villa_p_15:
Villa Beit HaLogs is a unique vacation home in northern Israel, situated facing the pastoral views of the Sea of Galilee and wrapped in a nostalgic, heartwarming atmosphere. The villa is perfectly suited for 4 families who wish to share an experience together without sacrificing privacy — separate bedrooms for each family alongside shared spaces for meals, conversations, and moments of togetherness. Old-world charm with all the comforts of today. A luxury villa overlooking the Sea of Galilee, ideal for large families, groups of friends, or extended gatherings seeking the perfect blend of scenery, comfort, and luxury.
The enchanting view of the Sea of Galilee unfolds from every corner of the house — whether you're sipping coffee on the balcony, relaxing in the jacuzzi with a view, or soaking in your private heated pool.
The villa combines designed rustic architecture with modern elements and appliances, offering a 5-star hotel-level hospitality experience with all the comforts of home.
Villa Beit HaLogs is a vacation villa for families located at 47 HaHartzit Street in the village of Migdal, facing the Sea of Galilee in the northern region. The villa includes 5 bedrooms (suitable for 4 families, up to 18 guests), a private covered heated pool in winter, a spa jacuzzi, and a panoramic view of the Sea of Galilee.  
✅ Private heated pool
✅ Jacuzzi facing the Sea of Galilee
✅ Fully equipped kitchen
✅ Fast internet
✅ Free parking
villa_p_16: Villa Beit HaLogs offers five bedrooms furnished in an old rustic style, each with its own character. The rooms are filled with natural light, warmly furnished, and thoughtfully designed for families — a place to rest, gather, and experience the north together.
villa_p_18:
The main room of the villa — spacious, quiet, and bathed in morning light. A wide double bed, raw wood furniture crafted by local hands, and the feeling of a real home. Suitable for a couple or two young children alongside their parents.
In the living area, there is a pull-out sofa for the children to sleep on, with the option of opening an additional single bed.
Each suite has a large bathroom (the South Suite has 2 entrance doors — allowing guests in rooms 4–5 to enter without disturbing the residents of the South Suite).
villa_p_20: Room 4 and Room 5 offer privacy for a couple, with the option of a pull-out sofa or alternatively — a children's room.
villa_p_22: The Studio Suite accommodates a small family — a double bed and a pull-out sofa that converts into a double bed.

nearby_p_14: Villa Beit HaLogs is nestled in the heart of the Galilee, surrounded by a rich and breathtaking landscape — between lush vineyards and the skies of the Sea of Galilee shimmering on the horizon. From here, every enchanting destination in northern Israel is just around the corner.
nearby_p_15: Whether you choose to stroll along the shores of the Sea of Galilee, visit the ancient markets of Safed, taste wine in the Golan, or simply rest and breathe in the mountain air — the villa serves as the perfect base for a full family experience in northern Israel, with all the comforts you'll need at the end of each day.
nearby_p_16: Genuine experiences from guests who stayed at the villa
nearby_p_17: Just a few steps from the villa and you're already on the shores of the Sea of Galilee. A quiet morning with coffee, a swim at noon, and a sunset that will stay with you forever — a complete experience in its own right.
nearby_p_19: Walking distance from the villa to the Arbel Cliffs, climbing to the caves and a breathtaking view of the Ginosar Valley
nearby_p_21: Magdala is an ancient fishing village that existed right at the beautiful shores of the Sea of Galilee. In simpler terms, around the turn of the Common Era. Magdala was the largest city here before the founding of Tiberias.
nearby_p_23: Lower Nahal Tzalmon - After years of being completely dry, in autumn 2025 the lower section of Nahal Tzalmon came back to life! Thanks to the flow of desalinated water into the Sea of Galilee as part of the "Reverse Carrier" project, clear water now flows along the stream, filling several wonderful pools. The most beautiful and deepest pool of all is located beneath an ancient bridge, known as the "Travertine Bridge". In days gone by, an ancient aqueduct crossed the bridge, carrying the stream's water to a flour mill. Water seeping from the aqueduct created beautiful stalactites on the bridge, giving it a unique appearance. The combination of the beautiful bridge, the clear and deep pool beneath it, and the sound of water flowing powerfully, creates a wonderful place to bathe in. Those who wish can add 2 more nearby pools to their visit — the Round Pool and the Waterfall Pool.
nearby_p_25: Lower Nahal Amud is one of the wildest and most impressive trails in the Lower Galilee. It is a one-way trail passing through a deep and spectacular stream channel, alongside high cliffs, prehistoric caves, archaeological remains, and small springs. Along the way you will also encounter the famous "Amud" — a giant limestone rock pillar that gave the stream its name. The trail is unregulated, free of charge, and is especially suitable for transitional seasons — winter and spring.

experience_p_17: Villa Beit HaLogs is nestled in the heart of the North, surrounded by the quiet of morning. Here, four families can share a long breakfast at the large table, listen to the birds through the windows, and rediscover the simplicity we've almost forgotten. The villa was designed in an old-world style — with warm rustic furniture and five rooms, each telling its own story.
experience_p_18: The heated covered pool awaits you even on winter days, and the five rooms allow each family their own corner — without losing the sense of togetherness. A villa for rent for several families in the North that feels like grandpa's house, only with all the comfort you need.
experience_p_20: At Villa Beit HaLogs, four families can live together without feeling crowded. Every moment — breakfast, afternoon hours by the pool, the shared evening — unfolds naturally, warmly, and at your own pace.
experience_p_21: In the lower yard, there is a large table for outdoor dining alongside charcoal or gas grills — your choice.
experience_p_22:
The heated covered pool is open all year round, allowing children to swim while the adults relax comfortably beside them. The space is large enough for everyone to feel at ease, and intimate enough so the children won't get lost. 
Sunbathing loungers and ample seating, plus a ping-pong table overlooking the view.
experience_p_23: The jacuzzi, large and accommodating up to 5 guests, faces a breathtaking view.
experience_p_26: Villa Beit HaLogs is nestled in the heart of the North, on a hill overlooking the Sea of Galilee — a space where nature, silence, and Mediterranean light merge into an experience that is hard to put into words. From the moment you arrive, the landscape unfolds before you like a painting: blue-grey waters, green orchards, and wide skies that change with the hours of the day.
experience_p_27: The villa is designed to allow four families to vacation together, while maintaining a true sense of home — not a hotel, not a standard guesthouse. Here, among 5 spacious bedrooms and a heated covered pool, the moments you'll remember for years unfold: shared dinners, late-night conversations, and mornings with coffee facing the view.
experience_p_28: The area offers genuine rural tranquility — far from the hustle, close to everything that matters. Villa Beit HaLogs is the perfect base for a shared family vacation in the North, where every day begins with a deep breath and ends with satisfaction.
experience_p_31: Villa Beit HaLogs was designed especially for families who want to share a joint experience — with enough space for everyone. Before booking, it's worth making sure we're the perfect match for you.
experience_p_32: A: The villa is located in the Migdal colony, facing the Sea of Galilee.
experience_p_33: A: We host up to 4 families, up to 18 guests simultaneously — brothers and sisters with their children, extended family, or a group of close friends. Especially suitable for those who want to spend time together without compromising on privacy and comfort.
experience_p_34: A: The villa is suitable for long weekends, holidays, and family events such as birthdays and anniversaries. A stay of 2–4 nights allows you to enjoy the heated covered pool, explore the Galilee, and relax on the shores of the Sea of Galilee.
experience_p_35: A: 5 bedrooms with 3 separate bathrooms ensure that each family maintains its independence. The shared space — the living room, kitchen, and pool — is the beating heart that connects everyone in the moments that truly matter.
experience_p_36: A: The community is mostly secular and partly traditional — there are no restrictions in this regard.
